title: WOS Studio (Authoring) — ExportBundle
description: ExportBundle envelope per studio/specs/compiler-contract.md SA-MUST-cmp-062/063 (workspace-export disaster-recovery primitive) and SA-MUST-cmp-080..084 (per-element justificationTrail, Stage 8 enhancement E3). Carries sources + PolicyObjects + mappings + scenarios + provenance log + custody-anchored receipts + (E3) per-generated-element justificationTrail. The bundle is self-contained: every external reference is either inlined or carries a hash + URI per SA-MUST-cmp-063. justificationTrail is the load-bearing addition for E3 — every generated artifact element (form field, workflow step, decision rule, public-guidance fragment) carries the explicit set of accepted PolicyObject ids and SourceCitation refs that justify it, with trustZone constrained to Z5 or Z7 (candidate-state material is rejected by the schema's trustZone enum and SA-MUST-cmp-082 lint).
$comment: Promotion status (Stage-8 enhancement E3, 2026-05-08): MVP shape; the bundle's non-justificationTrail content is intentionally permissive (additionalProperties: true) so this schema can land without retrofitting full ExportBundle structure — that work is a future spec pass. justificationTrail is the structurally-enforced contribution of E3.

x-lm.intent: Document type marker for the Studio ExportBundle envelope

$wosStudioExportBundle.description: Document marker pinning this artifact to the Studio ExportBundle 1.0 schema.

compileManifestRef.description: Reference to the compile manifest produced by phase 9 emission. Carries reproducibility metadata per SA-MUST-cmp-060/061.

sources.description: Source documents bundled into the export. Entries reference workspace SourceVersion ids; inlining policy is per SA-MUST-cmp-063.

policyObjects.description: PolicyObjects in `approved`+ lifecycle state at compile time.

scenarios.description: Scenario suite that exercised the published workflow.

provenanceLog.description: AuthoringProvenanceRecords spanning the workflow's authoring history.

justificationTrail.description: Per-element justification trail per SA-MUST-cmp-080..084 (Stage 8 enhancement E3). Every generated artifact element MUST appear with at least one justifying PolicyObject and at least one citation; trustZone is constrained to Z5 (canonical) or Z7 (published) — candidate-state material is structurally rejected.

JustificationTrailEntry.description: One generated-artifact-element ↔ accepted-PolicyObject(s) ↔ SourceCitation(s) tuple. Per SA-MUST-cmp-080..084. The four fields are all required — partial trail entries are rejected by the schema and by CMP-LINT-080 lint at S6.

justifiedBy.description: PolicyObject ids that justify this element. MUST be non-empty per SA-MUST-cmp-081. Each id MUST resolve to a PolicyObject in `approved`+ lifecycle state at compile time; CMP-LINT-082 enforces.

citations.description: SourceCitation ids that ground the justification in primary source material. MUST be non-empty per SA-MUST-cmp-081.

trustZone.description: Trust zone of the justifying material per E2's Z0–Z7 overlay. Constrained to Z5 (canonical) or Z7 (published) — candidate-state material (Z2/Z3) and pre-canonical reviewed material (Z4) are structurally rejected per SA-MUST-cmp-082.

x-lm.intent: Trust-zone floor for justification entries — load-bearing for CMP-LINT-082 publication-blocker rule

rationale.description: Optional reviewer rationale for the trail entry. RECOMMENDED when the element is generated by AI projection (Stage 8 deliverables 9–10).

ElementRef.description: Reference to a generated artifact element. `kind` discriminates between projection-target element types; `ref` is the target-specific identifier (form-field id, workflow-step id, decision-rule id, public-guidance-fragment id).

kind.description: Generated element kind. Each projection target declares which kinds it emits per SA-MUST-bind-080.

ref.description: Target-specific identifier of the generated element (e.g., `formField:applicant.income`, `workflowStep:phase-4-eligibility-check`, `decisionRule:dt-snap-eligibility-row-7`).
